subject.title: feat: support GPT-5.6 Ultra across OpenClaw and Codex runtimes

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this combined GPT-5.6 Ultra contract now, including the two fresh-setup default changes and the additive public runtime-resolution Plugin SDK seam?
rationale: The patch is technically sound and matches Codex, but onboarding defaults and external plugin/provider contracts are durable product choices that cannot be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Adopt the combined contract
options.body: Land the full runtime, persistence, fresh-default, and additive SDK behavior after exact-head checks and merge refresh pass.

options.title: Narrow before landing
options.body: Keep the runtime and Codex lifecycle work but defer either the fresh defaults or public SDK export to a separately approved change.

options.title: Pause preview adoption
options.body: Keep the PR open until GPT-5.6 preview availability and permanent Ultra semantics are clearer.

recommendation.title: Adopt the combined contract
recommendation.body: Land the full runtime, persistence, fresh-default, and additive SDK behavior after exact-head checks and merge refresh pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete, who authored and integrated the current product-scope branch and has the strongest evidence of ownership over the decision surface.
